name: Atmosphere mark
summary: The Atmosphere's placeholder mark. Named “Atmosphere” when it stands alone, and decorative beside words that already say it.

when: Beside Atmosphere's name, or alone where it identifies the Atmosphere.

whenNot.text: Inside Continue with Atmosphere, which draws its own.

anatomy.description: A dot inside an open ring, in the icon colour.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Hides it from screen readers, beside words that say “Atmosphere”.

accessibility.name: “Atmosphere”, which is never translated.
screenReader: Announced as an image called Atmosphere, unless decorative.

dosAndDonts.do: Make it decorative beside the word “Atmosphere”.

evidence.point: The mark is a placeholder until the community agrees one.
